❓ FAQ — VTuber Services ▼
What software do I need for facial tracking?
I use iFacialMocap or VTube Studio (iPhone) through VSeeFace. You need an iPhone for best tracking. Android users can try Meowface, though quality differs.
What files will I receive?
.FBX, .BLEND, Unity project, .TGA/.PNG textures. .PSD on request.
What characters do you NOT accept?
Furry, robots, male characters, NFT projects, or designs not approved by me personally.
Can I change the design mid-process?
Minor tweaks may be possible. Significant changes after work begins require extra payment. Please finalize your design before commissioning.
What should my reference art look like?
Front, back, and side views required. No rough sketches or low-detail refs. You must own rights to the artwork.
📜 Terms of Service — VTuber Services ▼

Price is confirmed before work begins and remains fixed. Significant design changes after start require additional payment.

You receive full ownership for personal or commercial use (not for resale). Do not claim the artwork as your own. Credit me in your Twitter profile.

Work does not begin until 50% prepayment. If final payment is not made, I may use/resell the model.

Disrespectful behavior or extended silence without notice = cancellation. Orders are first-come, first-served.

NFT strictly prohibited. No use in NFT or NFT-related projects under any circumstance.

コミッションや個人依頼は、購入者と制作者の両方が購入済みである必要があります。

Commissions and private requests must be purchased by both the buyer and the creator.

FAQ
How will I receive my purchase?
All products are delivered digitally immediately after purchase through the shop platform.
Do you offer refunds?
Due to the nature of digital products, refunds are generally not available after download. However, refunds may be considered for broken or defective files.
Can I use the assets commercially?
Commercial use for games, merchandise, publications, or other commercial projects requires permission unless otherwise stated in the listing.
Can I edit the assets?
Personal modifications are allowed. However, support is not provided for issues caused by personal edits or unsupported models.
Can I share or redistribute the files?
No. Redistribution, resale, reuploading, or file sharing is strictly prohibited.
Are commissions/private edits allowed?
For commissions or private edits, both the creator and the customer must own a legitimate copy of the asset.
Terms of Service
By purchasing, downloading, or using these assets, you agree to the current Terms of Service. Terms may be updated at any time — the latest version always applies.

About
This store provides digital 3D assets, VRChat assets, textures, accessories, and related downloadable content. All products are digital downloads only. No physical products are shipped.

License & Personal Use
You may:

  • Use the assets for personal use
  • Modify models and textures for personal use
  • Create private edits or commission work, provided both the buyer and creator own a legitimate copy of the asset

We cannot provide support for issues caused by unsupported models or personal modifications.

Commercial Use
Commercial use in games, video productions, streams/content creation, merchandise, and publications may be permitted upon request.

Prohibited Uses
The following actions are strictly prohibited:

  • Redistribution, resale, sharing, reuploading, or secondary distribution of the original files. This includes:
    • Sharing assets with third parties
    • Incorporating these assets into other avatars or products for resale without both parties owning a legitimate copy of the product
    • VRChat pedestalization / public upload distribution
  • Use for political or religious activities
  • Use intended to harass, defame, or slander individuals or organizations
  • Fraudulent or deceptive actions toward the creator

Copyright
The copyright of the 3D models, textures, and related data belongs to KissU.

Credit is not required, but always appreciated.

Disclaimer
The creator is not responsible for any damage, loss, conflicts, or issues resulting from the use of these assets.

Terms Updates
These terms may be updated or changed at any time. The latest published version will always apply.
